# vaultwarden_organization_policy (Resource)

This resource manages a policy of an organization.

Policies cannot be deleted: destroying the resource disables the policy and clears its data. Enabling some policies changes the organization's members: `two_factor_authentication` revokes members without two-step login, and `single_org` revokes members that belong to another organization. Owners and Admins are exempt.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example"
}

# A policy with settings
resource "vaultwarden_organization_policy" "master_password" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  type            = "master_password"
  enabled         = true

  data = jsonencode({
    minComplexity  = 3
    minLength      = 14
    requireUpper   = true
    requireLower   = true
    requireNumbers = true
    requireSpecial = true
  })
}

# A policy without settings
resource "vaultwarden_organization_policy" "disable_send" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  type            = "disable_send"
  enabled         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization
- `type` (String) The type of the policy. One of `disable_send`, `master_password`, `organization_user_notification`, `password_generator`, `personal_ownership`, `remove_unlock_with_pin`, `reset_password`, `restricted_item_types`, `send_options`, `single_org`, `two_factor_authentication`, `uri_match_defaults`. `personal_ownership` is the *Remove individual vault* policy, and `reset_password` the *Account recovery administration* policy. `organization_user_notification` requires Vaultwarden 1.37 or later.

### Optional

- `data` (String) The settings of the policy as a JSON object, for the policy types that have settings, for example `jsonencode({ minLength = 12, requireUpper = true })` for `master_password`. The keys are the ones the Bitwarden clients use, such as `minComplexity`, `minLength`, `requireUpper`, `requireLower`, `requireNumbers` and `requireSpecial` for `master_password`, `disableHideEmail` for `send_options`, and `autoEnrollEnabled` for `reset_password`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the policy, in the format `<organization_id>/<type>`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vaultwarden_organization_policy.example <org_id>/<type>
```
